common.tagline: Online consultations and procedures in Tunisia

footer.about: Medelys connects you with verified doctors: teleconsultations with a certified prescription, or procedures with transfer, accommodation and follow-up.
footer.privacy: Your data is encrypted and only shared with your surgeon. Emails and bank statements stay discreet.
